declarations.type:
∀ {left middle right : SearchRouteCost.SearchRoute},
  SearchRouteCost.lexNoWorse left middle →
    SearchRouteCost.lexNoWorse middle right → SearchRouteCost.lexNoWorse left right
declarations.name: SearchRouteCost.lexNoWorse_trans

declarations.type: ∀ (left right : SearchRouteCost.SearchRoute), SearchRouteCost.lexNoWorse (SearchRouteCost.preferRoute left right) left
declarations.name: SearchRouteCost.preferRoute_lexNoWorse_left

declarations.type: ∀ (left right : SearchRouteCost.SearchRoute), SearchRouteCost.lexNoWorse (SearchRouteCost.preferRoute left right) right
declarations.name: SearchRouteCost.preferRoute_lexNoWorse_right

declarations.type:
∀ (requirement : SearchRouteCost.RouteRequirement) (budget : SearchRouteCost.RouteBudget)
  (routes : List SearchRouteCost.SearchRoute),
  SearchRouteCost.chooseShortestFeasible requirement budget routes = none →
    ∀ (route : SearchRouteCost.SearchRoute), route ∈ routes → SearchRouteCost.feasibleB requirement budget route = false
declarations.name: SearchRouteCost.chooseShortestFeasible_none_implies_infeasible

declarations.type:
∀ (requirement : SearchRouteCost.RouteRequirement) (budget : SearchRouteCost.RouteBudget)
  (routes : List SearchRouteCost.SearchRoute) (selected : SearchRouteCost.SearchRoute),
  SearchRouteCost.chooseShortestFeasible requirement budget routes = some selected →
    selected ∈ routes ∧ SearchRouteCost.feasibleB requirement budget selected = true
declarations.name: SearchRouteCost.chooseShortestFeasible_mem_and_feasible

declarations.type:
∀ (requirement : SearchRouteCost.RouteRequirement) (budget : SearchRouteCost.RouteBudget)
  (routes : List SearchRouteCost.SearchRoute) (selected : SearchRouteCost.SearchRoute),
  SearchRouteCost.chooseShortestFeasible requirement budget routes = some selected →
    ∀ (candidate : SearchRouteCost.SearchRoute),
      candidate ∈ routes →
        SearchRouteCost.feasibleB requirement budget candidate = true → SearchRouteCost.lexNoWorse selected candidate
declarations.name: SearchRouteCost.chooseShortestFeasible_is_lex_optimal
